chunks: Say: 'Imagine if the punishment of God were to come unawares, or openly, who will perish but the evil-doers?'
ai.seo_question: Who will perish when God's punishment arrives suddenly or openly?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-An'am, this verse serves as a rhetorical challenge to the polytheists of Mecca, asserting that divine retribution targets the unjust regardless of whether it strikes unexpectedly (baghtatan) or visibly (jahran). Shia exegetes often highlight this as a reminder of God's absolute justice, where the destruction of the ظالمين (wrongdoers) is a natural consequence of their own actions rather than arbitrary divine whim.
